summary: Full backend + frontend regression testing on Apex & Blade barber shop. 29 pytest tests cover public content, auth (register/login/logout/me), availability (Sunday closed, blackout empty, invalid service), booking creation with add-on totals, double-booking 409, customer /bookings/me with cancel, admin stats/bookings, all CRUD (services/addons/hairstyles/gallery/blackouts), settings auto_confirm toggle (pending status verified), and admin manual booking + status patch. Playwright covered Home/Services/Gallery/Contact loads, full 5-step guest booking flow ending on confirmation page with AB- reference, admin login->dashboard tabs (Settings incl. auto-confirm toggle), and role-protection (guest hitting /admin redirects to /login). Everything green.
critical_code_review_comments: compute_slots is called twice on booking creation (once implicitly for validation) - minor perf; fine for MVP.

GET /api/auth/me returns 401 for unauthenticated users which shows as console errors on every public page load (AuthContext pings /auth/me on mount). Consider suppressing 401 logs or checking a cheaper endpoint. Non-blocking.

Booking creation lets a logged-in customer pass any customer_email different from their own account; user_id is still linked, but appointments may end up under a different email. Consider forcing customer_email to user.email when logged in.
test_credentials: admin@apexblade.com / admin123 (admin). Customer registered per-run with TEST_ prefix.
seed_data_creation: Test bookings, service/addon/hairstyle/gallery/blackout CRUD entries all created and cleaned up within tests. Some TEST_* prefixed bookings remain in DB (guest + customer bookings on future dates and one manual admin booking) - safe (future dates only).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend tests live at /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py, run via `pytest backend/tests/backend_test.py -v --junitxml=/app/test_reports/pytest/pytest_results.xml`. Uses REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL from /app/frontend/.env. Full guest booking flow, admin dashboard and role protection verified via Playwright. Auto-confirm was toggled off then restored back to on during tests.
